decision: Keep verification-row head tiling. The 25.6k single-client edit gain repeated. In six-client tests the edit gained 1.32% and 404k coding gained 3.06% against their bracketing controls with longer repetitions already enabled. Starting-image comparisons with both changes measured +6.08% on the single-client edit, -1.92% on 404k after edits, and approximately flat for a fresh 404k session.
suite: One warm-up and six warm waves per workload on a freshly started process for each leg. Edit first, then coding.
devices: host GPUs 1, 2; RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, 375 W per GPU, 225 W CPU socket
edit: 25,625 input, 1,500 output, published first-token-to-end metric including reasoning; deterministic edit of functions 50–90.
long: 404,151 input, 512 output, first-to-last visible text excluding first token; frozen coding history.
base_profile: compose.yml + compose.c1-optimized.yml; DS4_BATCH_TOPK=1, DS4_EXPERT_EVICTION=lfu, DS4_C1_OUTPUT_CONSENSUS=1, DS4_PROMPT_LOOKUP=1, DS4_OUTPUT_LOOKUP=single, DS4_ADAPTIVE_LOOKUP=1, DS4_LOOKUP_K=128. Each leg additionally sets the flags in config.

micro-summary.shape: 129280 vocabulary x 5120 hidden, rank-local projection, one split, synthetic nonzero signed FP8 weights and per-row scales, 3 dispatches per event sample, 8 timed samples per leg

starting_service.timing: read back after baseline on the same configured release

source_rebuild.comparison: After adding test-only coverage, every allocated ELF section except the build ID matched the deployed executable byte for byte.
